description: Search the open-source icon library (Feather, Lucide, Tabler, Heroicons, custom icons and Unicode symbols) by keyword. Returns icon ids for get_icon_svg, with source and license.

limit.description: Maximum number of icons to return. Default 10.

query.description: Keywords such as "rocket", "shopping cart" or "arrow". Empty lists the first icons.

source.description: Only icons from this source, e.g. "Feather" or "Lucide".

name: search_icons
title: Search the icon library
